# Release Verification

## Scope
The release covers account access, exports, and scheduled maintenance.
The calibration interval remains thirty days for all regional sensors.

## Interface Checks
| Case | Category | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TC-LOGIN | Authentication | Pass |
| TC-EXPORT | Data Export | Pass |
| TC-AUDIT | Audit Trail | Pass |

## Performance
Record ID: PERF-001
Category: Throughput
Result: Pass
Notes: Sustained throughput remained above the target.

Record ID: PERF-002
Category: Latency
Result: Pass
Notes: Tail latency remained below the limit.

## Operations FAQ
Q: FAQ-ROLLBACK When is rollback approval required?
A: Approval is required before the rollback window opens.

Q: FAQ-OWNER Who owns the maintenance notice?
A: The operations lead publishes the notice.

## Retry Example
```go
func RetryTimeout() error {
    return errors.New("timeout")
}
```

## Retention
The retention schedule keeps audit artifacts for ninety days.
The archive verification job runs every Friday.

## Closing Notes
Regional owners confirm the checklist after deployment.
The support handoff includes the incident contact matrix.

## Oversized Inspection Log
| Slot | Owner | Status | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-01 | North Desk | Pass | Slot one records the desk inspection pass. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-02 | East Desk | Pass | Slot two records the desk inspection pass. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-03 | South Desk | Pass | Slot three records the desk inspection pass. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-04 | West Desk | Pass | Slot four records the desk inspection pass. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-05 | Night Desk | Pass | Slot five records the desk inspection pass. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-06 | Harbor Desk | Hold | Slot six waits for the signed checklist. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-07 | Alpine Desk | Hold | Slot seven waits for the signed checklist. |
| OVERSIZE-ROW-08 | Prairie Desk | Hold | Slot eight waits for the signed checklist. |

# 运维手册

## 目录
- 数据导出恢复流程
- 中文巡检结果
- 跨页交付步骤

## 正文：数据导出恢复流程
恢复编号 BODY-DELIVERY-9。数据导出失败后先核验对象存储校验和，再重新生成下载链接。
灾备演练每季度执行一次，并由值班负责人归档演练记录。

| CN-TABLE-8 | 权限复核 | 已完成 |

## 中文常见问题
Q: FAQ-CN-BACKUP 备份失败后由谁确认？
A: 存储管理员确认快照完整性，值班经理批准再次执行。
